candidates.name: BALONCUKLAR

candidates.name: KATMAN

candidates.name: PIKSEL
candidates.detail: Top-left label "C08 / PIKSEL". Distinct retro game dialog made of individual floating PIXEL-EDGED speech strips. Input is a compact wide cream strip about 405px by 60px, stepped 4px square corners and a double-line terracotta/dark-brown outline, no smooth rounding. Pet sits immediately LEFT and slightly BELOW input, grounding the cluster. Each message above has its own tight cream or dark-brown speech strip, stair-step corners and short pixel tail. User strips dark brown with cream text align right; assistant strip cream with dark text aligns left. Deliberate asymmetric stack with visible dark desktop gaps and no enclosing frame. UI typography is readable coarse mono with subtle game-dialog character, no ornate border art. Tiny integrated square terracotta send button, no other controls. More playful and visibly pixel constructed than C05, but quiet enough for a desktop.
